name: AgentTeams
description: 多 Agent 团队协作：AI 当队长，一句话组好带依赖的任务和持久成员，批准后成员自动领任务、互发消息，页面里实时看进度、任务依赖图和成员动态；任务可加质量门（合同、完成证据、评审不过自动修复 + 复审）。产品模型移植自 NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams。

agent_teams_create.description: 创建团队（你是队长）：目标、成员和带依赖的任务；默认是待批准的方案

agent_teams_approve.description: 用户同意后批准方案并开始运行

agent_teams_edit_plan.description: 待批准阶段整体修改方案

agent_teams_remove_member.description: 移除成员，他没做完的任务退回待办

agent_teams_create_task.description: 追加一个可以依赖已有任务的任务

agent_teams_reassign_task.description: 改派任务，旧的尝试作废

agent_teams_update_task.description: 更新任务状态并提交结果

agent_teams_amend_task.description: 队长修订任务合同，需要写原因

agent_teams_status.description: 看团队进展并取走未读消息，可等待新进展

agent_teams_resume.description: 恢复被用户暂停的团队

en.name: AgentTeams
en.description: Multi-agent teams: the AI acts as captain, plans dependency-aware tasks with durable members, and after approval members claim tasks and message each other while the page shows progress, the task graph and member activity; tasks can carry quality gates (contract, evidence, automatic repair + re-review). The product model is ported from NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams.
